facts.summary: Registrational cohort ORR of 29%, below the prior cohort's 35% · Pivotal · lifileucel in advanced melanoma · BLA planned, not yet approved

evidence.summary: In registrational Cohort 4 (n=87), the objective response rate (ORR) by an independent review committee (IRC) using RECIST 1.1 criteria was 29% (95% confidence interval (CI): 19.5%, 39.4%)
evidence.safety: The treatment-emergent adverse event profile in both cohorts was consistent with the underlying disease and known adverse event profiles of non-myeloablative lymphodepletion and interleukin-2 (IL-2)
